Name: (AT) Strawberry Shortcake Farmhouse and Mailbox - Seasonal
Author: armoredlovecat
Description:
This mod replaces the vanilla farmhouse 1,2 and 3 and the mailbox with a Seasonal Strawberry Shortcake inspired version using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url].

To change the texture, you can use the Paint Bucket tool on the house and mailbox. This tool is purchasable from Robin.
Sometimes the mailbox texture won't change from one season to another so you must change it manually.

It was suggested in commets that I should make a [b][size=5]grassless version[/size][/b] so that the mod is compatible with recolors so it is now available as an [b]optional file[/b] in two formats: without grass and path and without grass only.

I'm thinking about making an inside and outside collection of furniture, so let me know if you have any suggestions ⭑.ᐟ
